description: Extracts a visual contract from a reference URL and saves it as JSON at outputPath. Call this once per reference design, before check_implementation or diff_pixels can be used, since both need a saved contract to compare against. Pass screenshotDir to also capture reference screenshots, which diff_pixels requires later. Returns a summary: the element count per viewport, any extraction warnings, and the path the contract was written to.

freezeAnimations.description: Freeze CSS animations before measuring. Defaults to true.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of only the viewport. Defaults to true.

headless.description: Run the browser headless. Defaults to true.

masks.description: CSS selectors to exclude from the walk, for example ads or timestamps.

maxElements.description: Maximum elements to walk, 0 means unbounded. Defaults to 600.

maxStates.description: Maximum interactive elements to probe for hover and focus. Defaults to 120.

outputPath.description: Filesystem path to write the contract JSON to, for example ./contracts/home.json.

screenshotDir.description: Directory to save reference screenshots to. Required later for diff_pixels to work.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope the walk to. Defaults to the document body.

timeout.description: Navigation timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

url.description: The reference URL to extract a visual contract from.

viewports.description: Viewports to capture. Defaults to desktop 1440x900, tablet 768x1024, mobile 390x844.

wait.description: Extra settle time in milliseconds after navigation. Defaults to 2000.

name: extract_contract
title: Extract a visual contract
